l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_01_adv_voice_linkstory_yomogi_shizuku_10605_040_8b79999e
l2d_voice#2.Text: 该道谢的是我才对……谢谢你的汽水…… 那我不客气啦……！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_04_adv_voice_anotherstory_10456_050
l2d_voice#2.Text: 早—— 怎么就蓬咲你一个人啊……诶！？你在哭……？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_adv_voice_linkstory_yomogi_shizuku_10603_007_687735c3
l2d_voice#2.Text: 这些叫粗点心，是平民吃的零食！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_adv_voice_anotherstory_10456_057
l2d_voice#2.Text: ……不太懂你在说什么， 不过你把准备工作都做完了，真是帮大忙了

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_12_adv_voice_kadan_005_1_17_004_dc553a34
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我们该不会，被拉黑了吧……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_13_adv_voice_kadan_005_1_12_097_7c99db6e
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我、我完全听不懂你在说什么！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_14_spot_05_01_01_yomogi_01_after_7626f3ff
l2d_voice#2.Text: 呀————！！ 别看着我，心脏要跳出来了～～～！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_15_adv_voice_linkstory_yomogi_shizuku_10604_041_3caa6952
l2d_voice#2.Text: 矢仓蓬咲，奇迹般地完成任务啦～～～！！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_16_adv_voice_linkstory_miku_yomogi_10592_013_4c670c5d
l2d_voice#2.Text: 挖、挖掘《鬼时雨》感想也包含在内！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_17_adv_voice_kadan_005_1_10_038
l2d_voice#2.Text: 明明大家说的都不是这回事……！！ 我们说的不是这回事！！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_18_adv_voice_anotherstory_10456_052
l2d_voice#2.Text: 不是，都哭成这样了还勉强自己一个人干…… 蕾叶她们呢？

l2d_voice_short#2.Name: adv_voice_kadan_005_1_12_097_7c99db6e

talk_short.Text:
……不太懂你在说什么，
不过你把准备工作都做完了，真是帮大忙了

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_anotherstory_10456_059
talk_medium.Text:
你看，连器材安装调试都弄好了。
平时这些都是交给蕾叶的吧

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_anotherstory_10456_064
talk_medium.Text:
啊——那饮料吧台的准备工作就拜托你了。
这边的灯光我来弄

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_eventstory_8_01_023
talk_medium.Text:
距、距离那次才过去不到一个月啊……！
需要办这么多回演出吗……！？

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_eventstory_8_01_031
talk_medium.Text:
是的……在规定时间内啪嗒啪嗒地敲键盘录入数据……
结果敲得肩膀都僵硬了……

talk_long.Name: adv_voice_eventstory_8_01_049
talk_long.Text:
一、不会因为Family
让任何人放弃自己珍视的东西，是这个吧？

talk_long.Name: adv_voice_kadan_005_1_10_038
talk_long.Text:
